title: Persona-Based Simulation Checks
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting persona-based simulation checks to cognitive load diagnosis table with intrinsic/extraneous/germane load evidence, social annotation signals, and adaptive learner-model evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze a cognitive load diagnosis table with intrinsic/extraneous/germane load evidence as evidence of learner judgment in AIL 606.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Identify annotation, artifact, support, and calibration signals for intelligent textbook research.
